_comment: Persona B, the cross-persona control for A: B's weights, 3000 steps, clipping 1.0, the four original report questions (the Qwen3-8B run was 20261109-214726, 'B-old'). On Qwen/Qwen3-14B.
Persona B (loose_leaf_tea): weights caffeine_content 0, leaf_size 100, oxidation_level 20, steeping_time -50, resteep_potential -70; screen: caffeine_content at 50% of its range.
The data folder is the Qwen3-8B experiment's: trials and answers do not depend on the model.
Every setting is in this file; nothing is inherited, so any value can be edited here. README 'Settings' explains each field.

Sized for Qwen/Qwen3-14B on a 24 GB card (L4, A10, RTX 4090, RTX 3090): micro_batch_size 2, eval batches 4 (decision 4, introspection 1). Qwen3-14B in 4-bit is about 10 GB, as tight on 24 GB as 8B is on 16 GB. Out of memory: micro_batch_size 1, then report_schema.max_new_tokens 200.
Run: python scripts/run_one_persona.py --settings configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona_qwen3_14b/base/persona_b/one_persona_minimum_threshold_b_14b_24gb.json
Notes, written when this file listed only its changes over one_persona_minimum_threshold.json (those values are now written out here too):
Persona B: the cross-persona control for the one-persona run 20261106-152354 (persona A). Same persona
(loose_leaf_tea, 'Imagine you are Djedefre'), same attributes, same caffeine screen (50% of range, 35 mg), same
trial seeds and shares, same report questions; only the weights differ:
A: caffeine_content 0, leaf_size -83, oxidation_level -38, steeping_time -100, resteep_potential 31
B: caffeine_content 0, leaf_size 100, oxidation_level  20, steeping_time  -50, resteep_potential -70
B's weights sum to 0, so a constant reply (all -100 or all +100) scores cosine 0 against them; they run against the
untrained model's ranking of the attributes (centred -0.74 vs its step-0 report) and against A (cosine -0.34).
If B's reports follow B's weights better than A's, the reports carry what training put there, not attribute-name
priors or a template. Score with: python tools/cross_persona_control.py results/<B run> --against <A run>.
Differs from run A on purpose: max_grad_norm 1.0 (A had none and spiked at step 5428), 3000 steps instead of
10000 (A's faithful stretch was 1500-2750), optimizer state saved for the last checkpoint only (disk).
natural_val_trials_per_persona 1000 is validation only; it does not touch training or reports.
Everything else comes from one_persona_minimum_threshold.json and the files it extends.
Built (LF line endings) from data/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_b/one_persona_minimum_threshold_b/ with
python data/general/vector_dataset_constructor.py --settings configs/minimum_threshold_one_persona/base/persona_b/one_persona_minimum_threshold_b.json
